title: Lecture → Self attention with trainable weights
extracted_text:
2) Compute attention weights ← The attention weights are a normalized version of the attention scores

3) Compute context vectors ← The context vectors are computed as a weighted sum over the inputs

In this section, we will learn about the self attention mechanism used in the original transformer architecture, the GPT models and most other popular LLMs.

This self attention mechanism is also called as "scaled dot-product attention"
diagram_summary: Flow diagram showing two steps in attention computation: computing attention weights (normalized attention scores) and computing context vectors (weighted sum over inputs).
